summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, announcing a recommendation from its nomination committee for the election of Jarle Roth as new chair of the board of directors, along with re-election of other board members. The current chair, Jon Erik Reinhardsen, is resigning. The election will occur at the corporate assembly meeting on June 8, 2026, effective July 1, 2026. This is a routine governance update and not a forced or abrupt management change. As a non-US filing, the Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K for foreign private issuers.
